mapper.sql: p.MODEL_PROCESS_ID AS modelProcessId, p.PROCESS_AREA_CODE AS processAreaCode, COALESCE(d.CODE_VALUE_NAME_KO, d.CODE_VALUE_NAME) AS processName, p.MODEL_NAME AS modelName, p.AUTOMATION_NAME AS automationName, p.SERVER_IP AS serverIp, p.AGENT_ID AS agentId, p.PYTHON_PROJECT_PATH AS pythonProjectPath, p.PROCESS_STATUS AS processStatus, p.MONITORING_STATUS AS monitoringStatus, p.CONTROL_STATUS AS controlStatus, p.LAST_STATUS_TIMESTAMP AS lastStatusTimestamp, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, ( SELECT CASE mc.COMMAND_STATUS WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'REQUESTED' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE mc.COMMAND_STATUS END FROM TB_M26_MODEL_COMMAND mc WHERE mc.MODEL_PROCESS_ID = CAST(p.MODEL_PROCESS_ID AS CHAR) AND mc.DATA_END_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY mc.CREATED_TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS controlRequestStatus

FROM TB_M26_MODEL_PROCESS p LEFT JOIN TB_M26_CODE c ON UPPER(c.CODE_NAME) = 'PROCESS_AREA' AND c.DATA_END_STATUS = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_M26_CODE_DETAIL d ON d.CODE_ID = c.CODE_ID AND d.CODE_VALUE = p.PROCESS_AREA_CODE AND d.DATA_END_STATUS = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT d.CODE_VALUE AS codeValue, COALESCE(d.CODE_VALUE_NAME_KO, d.CODE_VALUE_NAME) AS displayName, d.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM TB_M26_CODE c JOIN TB_M26_CODE_DETAIL d ON d.CODE_ID = c.CODE_ID WHERE UPPER(c.CODE_NAME) = 'PROCESS_AREA' AND c.DATA_END_STATUS = 'N' AND d.DATA_END_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY d.SORT_ORDER, d.CODE_DETAIL_ID

SELECT
WHERE p.DATA_END_STATUS = 'N'
AND p.PROCESS_AREA_CODE IN
#{area}
ORDER BY p.PROCESS_AREA_CODE, p.MODEL_PROCESS_ID

SELECT MODEL_EVENT_LOG_ID AS modelEventLogId, OCCURRED_TIMESTAMP AS occurredTimestamp, SEVERITY AS severity, MESSAGE AS message, DETECTION_SUMMARY AS detectionSummary FROM TB_M26_MODEL_EVENT_LOG WHERE MODEL_PROCESS_ID = #{id} AND DATA_END_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY OCCURRED_TIMESTAMP DESC, MODEL_EVENT_LOG_ID DESC
